audience: support teams that answer customer chats in Freshchat

useCases.title: Find a customer and review their conversations
useCases.text: Search customers by name, e-mail, reference id or phone. Then list the conversations of that customer and open one to see its status and assignment.

useCases.title: Catch up on a conversation before you reply
useCases.text: Open a conversation and read its messages, oldest first. Ask the assistant for a short summary of the open questions before you answer.

useCases.title: Choose the right team for a customer request
useCases.text: List the support agents with their groups, roles and availability, the agent groups and the channels. Use the lists to decide which team should handle the request.

useCases.title: Reply to a customer in a conversation
useCases.text: Read the conversation and its messages first. Then send a plain-text agent reply. The customer sees the reply at once, so check the text before you send it.
